item.name: CTL08 OPT-IN: dispatch exactly one LED command

request.description: May change real LEDs and insert action_history. Requires enable_hardware_tests=true and hardware_confirmation=SEND_ONE_COMMAND. One request only; no retries. target=1|2|3|4|all; action=ON|OFF. HTTP 202/PENDING is admission, not execution success.

exec: pm.test('Admission differs from execution', () => { pm.expect(j.id).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(['PENDING','FAILED']).to.include(j.status); pm.expect(j.action).to.eql(pm.environment.get('control_action')); if(j.status==='FAILED') pm.expect(j.reason).to.be.a('string'); }); if(pm.response.code===202 && Number.isInteger(j.id)) { pm.collectionVariables.set('command_id',j.id); pm.collectionVariables.set('dispatch_status',j.status); }

item.name: CTL09 OPT-IN: poll result of that command, never resend

request.description: Only polls the command ID captured by CTL08 in the same run. Bounded polling. FAILED is a completed failure, not SUCCESS. No new control request is sent.

exec: if(!pm.collectionVariables.get('command_id')){console.warn('BLOCKED: no command dispatched in this run');pm.execution.skipRequest();}

const max=Number(pm.environment.get('poll_max_attempts')||15); const delay=Number(pm.environment.get('poll_interval_ms')||1000); function finish(r) { pm.test('Command reaches terminal status',()=>pm.expect(['SUCCESS','FAILED']).to.include(r.status)); if(r.status==='FAILED') pm.test('FAILED includes reason',()=>pm.expect(r.reason).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty); console.log('COMMAND_TERMINAL',r.id,r.status,r.reason||''); pm.collectionVariables.set('terminal_status',r.status); } function poll(r,n) { if(r.status!=='PENDING'||n>=max) return finish(r); setTimeout(()=>pm.sendRequest({url:pm.environment.get('base_url')+'/api/actions/'+pm.collectionVariables.get('command_id'),method:'GET',header:{Authorization:'Bearer '+pm.environment.get('access_token')}},(err,res)=>{ pm.test('Poll transport and HTTP 200',()=>{pm.expect(err).to.eql(null); pm.expect(res.code).to.eql(200);}); if(!err && res.code===200) poll(res.json(),n+1); }),delay); } poll(j,0);

exec: pm.collectionVariables.unset('missing_action_id'); const base=pm.environment.get('base_url'); function probe(id,n){pm.sendRequest({url:base+'/api/actions/'+id,header:{Authorization:'Bearer '+pm.environment.get('access_token')}},(e,r)=>{if(!e&&r.code===404){pm.collectionVariables.set('missing_action_id',id);}else if(!e&&r.code===200&&n<5){probe(id-1,n+1);}else{console.warn('BLOCKED: cannot establish unused ID');pm.execution.skipRequest();}});}probe(1000000,0);
